selected.title: Goldman bans traders and bankers from using AI coding tools
selected.summary: Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding over productivity and risk concerns, according to Bloomberg
selected.why: Unexpected policy restriction on AI tool usage at a premier global investment bank.

reason: Goldman's AI coding ban tests whether financial firms should restrict tools to manage risk, or whether blanket prohibition wastes productivity gains and competitive advantage.
angle: Banning AI coding tools is security theatre that handicaps banks against both cyber threats and nimbler competitors.
